# Agent skill inventory — eye-quality

Central list of **first-party** agent assets in this repository for governance and periodic review.
Aligns with [OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10 — AST09](https://github.com/kenhuangus/agentic-skills-top-10#ast09--no-governance).

**Last reviewed:** 2026-07-26. Companion to [SKILL_COMPILATION.md](SKILL_COMPILATION.md) and
[SAFETY.md](SAFETY.md).

**How to use:** when adding or materially changing a skill, add a row or update **Last reviewed** in
the same PR.

**Canonical tree:** `.cursor/` — `.claude/` is generated by `python scripts/sync_assistant_trees.py`.
Never hand-edit `.claude/`.

## Risk tier (informal, for reviewers)

| Tier | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **L1** | Read-only or narrow guidance; no destructive defaults |
| **L2** | Instructs shell, training runs, or git — high agency; trust repo review |

## Commands (`.cursor/commands/`)

| Command | Purpose (short) |
|---------|-----------------|
| `/spec` | Feature or change specification with EARS acceptance criteria |
| `/plan` | Implementation plan: files, approach, tests, rollback |
| `/decompose` | Break a large task into parallelizable subtasks with a reducer |
| `/implement` | Minimal-diff implementation against an approved plan |
| `/test-and-fix` | Run the narrowest failing scope and fix root causes |
| `/pr-ready` | Definition-of-done report plus paste-ready PR text |
| `/compile-skill` | Lower a stable skill into a deterministic harness |
| `/mine` | Turn a document, repo, or transcript into agent assets |
| `/wiki-ingest` | Ingest a source into the docs wiki |
| `/wiki-lint` | Health-check the docs wiki (structure + OKF) |
| `/wiki-query` | Answer from the wiki; optionally file the synthesis |

## Rules (`.cursor/rules/`)

Always-on: `karpathy-coding`, `safety-and-secrets`, `sdlc-core`. Rules load on every task — the bar
for adding one is high.

## Frontmatter invariants (CI-enforced)

`python scripts/ci/check_agent_frontmatter.py` enforces:

- **Skills:** frontmatter required; `name` is the **first** key and matches the directory name;
  non-empty `description`; names unique across the tree.
- **Commands:** an H1 of the form `# /<name> …` must be present (frontmatter optional).
- **Rules:** frontmatter required with a non-empty `description`.
- **All files:** plain scalar frontmatter keys only — no exotic YAML tags (`!!`).

Violations fail the check; fix the asset rather than the checker.

## Verification

```bash
python scripts/sync_assistant_trees.py
python scripts/sync_assistant_trees.py --check
python scripts/ci/check_agent_frontmatter.py
python scripts/generate_agent_asset_inventory.py --check
python scripts/okf_lint.py --exclude-prefix archive/
python scripts/wiki_lint.py --exclude-prefix archive/
```
